ui.agents.teams.action.add_member.note: Appends a roster slot to the draft team. Sits at the end of the members section.

ui.agents.teams.action.collaboration_ari.role: accessible name for the collaboration-instructions field
ui.agents.teams.action.collaboration_ari.note: The visible section title is separate; this names the editable control for assistive tech. Same words as the section on purpose.

ui.agents.teams.action.new_chat.note: Starts a chat with this team as the target, manager-led.

ui.agents.teams.action.project_brief_ari.role: accessible name for the project-brief field
ui.agents.teams.action.project_brief_ari.note: Names the editable project brief; matches the section title beside it.

ui.agents.teams.action.remove.note: Drops this roster slot from the draft. Row-scoped, so it needs no object.

ui.agents.teams.col.count.note: How many of this slot the team declares. Narrow numeric column.

ui.agents.teams.col.member.note: Names the column of roster roles. Distinct from the section heading 'Members'.

ui.agents.teams.col.type.note: Whether the slot names an agent or a team; values come from kind.agent/kind.team.

ui.agents.teams.empty.not_found.note: A roster reference the resolver could not find and whose name the row did not carry. Short: it sits in a warning chip.

ui.agents.teams.empty.not_found_name.role: badge text naming the missing reference
ui.agents.teams.empty.not_found_name.note: {name} is the stored role or manager name (data, escaped, never translated). The colon and space are part of the message; the chip truncates if the name is long.

ui.agents.teams.field.manager_aria.role: accessible name for the manager picker
ui.agents.teams.field.manager_aria.note: Says what a manager is: the agent that leads the team's chat. The visible field label is shorter.

ui.agents.teams.field.manager_placeholde.note: Placeholder in the manager picker before a choice is made.

ui.agents.teams.field.member_placeholder.note: Placeholder in the add-member picker, which accepts either an agent or a team.

ui.agents.teams.kind.agent.note: The `agent` value of a roster slot or picker. Also the Type column's value, so keep it identical in both places.

ui.agents.teams.kind.team.note: The `team` value; pairs with kind.agent and shares its column width.

ui.agents.teams.member_count.role: count phrase used in prose and table summaries
ui.agents.teams.member_count.note: {count} is the declared member total for a team. ICU plural; the whole phrase is the message so the noun and its number agree in the target language.

ui.agents.teams.section.collaboration.note: The instructions the manager and members share. Also the field title in the editor.

ui.agents.teams.section.description.note: The team's one-line purpose; the field below is labelled 'What this team is for'.

ui.agents.teams.section.manager.note: The single agent that leads the team's chat. Also the field title for the same value.

ui.agents.teams.section.members.note: The roster of slots below the manager.

ui.agents.teams.section.members_aria.role: accessible name for the members table
ui.agents.teams.section.members_aria.note: Names the roster table for assistive tech; same word as the section heading.

ui.agents.teams.section.project_brief.note: The project context the team is briefed with. Also the field title when editing.

ui.agents.teams.section.what_for.note: Label above the description field in the editor; not the same string as the read-view heading 'Description'.

ui.agents.teams.field.name_hint.role: Description line under the Name section heading of the team form
ui.agents.teams.field.name_hint.note: Says the name is how the person and their chats address the team.

ui.agents.teams.field.name_label.role: Field label of the team name input
ui.agents.teams.field.name_label.note: Distinguishes the team's name from an agent's name elsewhere.

ui.agents.teams.section.manager_hint.role: Description line under the Manager section heading
ui.agents.teams.section.manager_hint.note: The manager is the single agent that leads a team chat and delegates to members.

ui.agents.teams.field.manager_label.role: Field label and accessible name of the manager picker
ui.agents.teams.field.manager_label.note: The picker also accepts a team as the manager value; the label names the usual case.

ui.agents.teams.field.manager_list_notic.role: Notice line in the manager picker's list
ui.agents.teams.field.manager_list_notic.note: States the scope of the options: only definitions stored on this computer.

ui.agents.teams.section.members_hint.role: Description line under the Members section heading
ui.agents.teams.section.members_hint.note: Members are the agents or teams the manager may hand work to, with a count and a model for each.

ui.agents.teams.field.loading_agents.role: Busy/status text while a member or manager picker loads
ui.agents.teams.field.loading_agents.note: Announced by assistive technology while the list is fetched.

ui.agents.teams.field.member_aria.role: Accessible name of a team member's agent picker
ui.agents.teams.field.member_aria.note: The number is the 1-based row position in the member table.

ui.agents.teams.field.member_kind_aria.role: Accessible name of a member row's agent-or-team type select

ui.agents.teams.action.fewer_aria.role: Accessible name of the decrement button of a member's count stepper
ui.agents.teams.action.fewer_aria.note: {role} is the member's role name taken from the team definition.

placeholders.role: Member role name from the team definition; do not translate.

ui.agents.teams.action.more_aria.role: Accessible name of the increment button of a member's count stepper
ui.agents.teams.action.more_aria.note: {role} is the member's role name taken from the team definition.

placeholders.role: Member role name from the team definition; do not translate.

ui.agents.teams.field.count_aria.role: Accessible name of a member row's current count
ui.agents.teams.field.count_aria.length: Two words plus a number and a name
ui.agents.teams.field.count_aria.note: Read out as '3 of reviewer'; the count is the number of copies of that member.

placeholders.role: Member role name from the team definition; do not translate.

ui.agents.teams.field.what_for_label.role: Field label of the team description textarea
ui.agents.teams.field.what_for_label.note: Labels the free-text purpose of the team.

ui.agents.teams.action.create.role: Primary button label when creating a new team
ui.agents.teams.action.create.note: Shown in the footer of the new-team form.

ui.agents.teams.action.creating.role: Pending label of the create button while the write is in flight
ui.agents.teams.action.creating.note: Replaces the create button's label until the write settles.

ui.agents.teams.action.discard_question.role: Confirmation hint on the team form's discard control
ui.agents.teams.action.discard_question.note: Asks before throwing away unsaved team edits.

ui.agents.teams.empty.description.role: Empty-state text where a team has no description
ui.agents.teams.empty.description.note: Shown in read mode in place of the description block.

ui.agents.teams.create.error_name_requir.role: Inline error under the team-name field when the operator creates a team without a name
ui.agents.teams.create.error_name_requir.tone: Plain imperative, sentence case, full stop
ui.agents.teams.create.error_name_requir.note: Sibling of the agent form's 'Give the agent a name.'; keep the two parallel.

ui.agents.teams.create.error_name_taken.role: Inline error under the team-name field when the name is already used by another team
ui.agents.teams.create.error_name_taken.tone: Plain statement, then the two remedies
ui.agents.teams.create.error_name_taken.note: Keep the curly quotes (or the locale's own quotation marks) around the name.

placeholders.name: the team name the operator typed; data, never translated

ui.agents.teams.create.error_instruction.role: Inline error under the collaboration-instructions field when a new team has none
ui.agents.teams.create.error_instruction.tone: Plain imperative, sentence case, full stop
ui.agents.teams.create.error_instruction.note: Sibling of the agent form's 'Give the agent instructions.'.

ui.agents.teams.edit.error_generic.role: Fallback alert text when saving a team failed and the failure carried no sentence of its own
ui.agents.teams.edit.error_generic.note: Sibling of the agent form's 'The agent could not be saved.'.

ui.agents.teams.create.title_new.role: Heading of the team pane while a team is being created

ui.agents.teams.includes_team.role: Suffix after the team's member count ('3 members · Includes a team') when one member is itself a team
ui.agents.teams.includes_team.note: Keep the leading middle dot: it separates this from the count before it. The space before the dot is added by the interface.

ui.agents.teams.group.agents.role: Section heading inside the manager/member picker list, above the agents
ui.agents.teams.group.agents.tone: Plural noun, title of a list group
ui.agents.teams.group.agents.note: Pairs with the 'Teams' heading in the same list.

ui.agents.teams.group.teams.role: Section heading inside the manager/member picker list, above the teams
ui.agents.teams.group.teams.tone: Plural noun, title of a list group
ui.agents.teams.group.teams.note: Pairs with the 'Agents' heading in the same list.
